name: caveman-blocks
description: Your agents write each script once, well, and reuse it. A pre-run hook that points Codex at the block in .blocks/ that already covers the script it is about to write.

interface.shortDescription: Write each script once. Reuse it as a verified block.
interface.longDescription: One PreToolUse hook on the shell tool. When Codex is about to run a script that an indexed block in your repo's .blocks/ already covers, it gets one line naming the block and the call. It never denies or rewrites a command and never leaves your repo. Needs the caveman-blocks binary on this machine.
